Chapter 1

show ip route
To display the current state of the routing table, use the show ip route command in privileged EXEC mode.

show ip route [vrf vrf-name] [ip-address [mask]]

Syntax Description
vrf vrf-name    (Optional) Displays routing information for the specified VRF.
ip-address      (Optional) Address about which routing information is displayed.

Command Modes
Privileged EXEC (#)

Command History
Release 17.3   This command was introduced.

Usage Guidelines
Use this command to verify routes learned via dynamic routing protocols.

Catalyst 9600 IP Routing Command Reference
12

show ip interface brief
To display a brief summary of an interface's IP information and status, use the show ip interface brief command in privileged EXEC mode.

show ip interface brief [type number]

Command Modes
Privileged EXEC (#)

Catalyst 9600 IP Routing Command Reference
18

clear ip route
To clear one or more routes from the IP routing table, use the clear ip route command in privileged EXEC mode.

clear ip route {* | network [mask]}

Command Modes
Privileged EXEC (#)
